exposure: Serum albumin (ALB) levels at NEC onset
Serum lactate levels at NEC onset
outcome: Severe NEC (defined as surgical NEC or NEC-related mortality)
cohort: The study included 88 preterm infants, with 60 diagnosed with severe NEC and 28 with non-severe NEC.
finding: Lower serum albumin levels and higher CRP levels at NEC onset were statistically significant independent risk factors for severe NEC in preterm infants.
